prompts.prompt: For network automation playbooks running on ansible-core 2.18, what is the minimum Python version required on the control node? Answer concisely.

When pushing configuration to a Cisco IOS device with Ansible, what ansible_become_method value must you set to enter privileged EXEC mode before config tasks run? Answer concisely with just the method name.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/ansible-network/SKILL.md - IOS requires ansible_become: yes and ansible_become_method: enable for privilege escalation

prompts.prompt: Which Ansible connection plugin is used almost universally for managing Juniper Junos devices, since every Junos module relies on it? Answer with just the plugin name.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/ansible-network/SKILL.md - netconf (NETCONF/XML) is preferred for Junos, all modules use NETCONF
